nominal_delay_s.description: ENGINEERING PRIOR ONLY. A cold-start hint for the decision layer. The simulator must never read this to generate delays and the kernel must never recover it — see risk R1. Learned 1/beta correlating above 0.95 with this field means we fit the config file, not a physical process.
